title: SAT and SMT proof artifact to certificate
obligation: Decide a bounded Boolean or theory instance and preserve a model or proof artifact for an independent checker.
rejection_policy: Reject a solver result without an exact encoding and solver version.
Reject UNSAT without a proof artifact accepted by an independent checker.
Reject SAT without a model that satisfies the original source constraints.
mathcert_route: check the model or proof artifact independently
verify the result maps back to the stated bounded obligation
claim_boundary: A checked SAT or SMT artifact certifies the encoded bounded instance, not an unstated family or informal source claim.
